claims: NASA astronauts are paid as federal employees under the General Schedule (GS) pay scale.
NASA astronauts' salaries range from approximately $104,898 to $161,141 annually as of 2024.
Experienced top-level NASA crew members' salaries generally top out around $152,000–$159,000.
NASA astronauts do not receive hazard pay for space missions.
NASA astronauts do not receive overtime for space missions.
NASA astronauts receive a small daily stipend of roughly $5 for incidentals.
Civilian astronauts start at GS-12 to GS-13 levels.
Civilian astronauts rise to GS-14 based on experience.
Astronauts do not receive extra pay for going to space.
Astronauts do not receive bonuses for going to space.
Canadian astronauts earn a salary that typically ranges from $97,100 to $189,600 per year.
Active-duty military astronauts are paid by the Department of Defense according to their rank.
Active-duty military astronauts are not paid under the GS scale.
Experienced astronauts in grades GS-13 to GS-14 earn a salary in the mid-$150,000 range.
Artemis II U.S. crew members' government salary tops out around $152,000.
The majority of Artemis II astronauts are positioned within the GS-13 to GS-14 levels.
